items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Barnett came through there and he played at Sweets

ctx.x: slight until it looked straight. But this little bus -- you know, they had these big diesels passing us like mad out there, this mountain whipped this bus. And we would get up into the mountains we all would have to get out and push it up curves around some of these curbs, you know. It just couldn't make it. And then we messed all of the transmission up trying to do this thing with this bus.

Any way, we finally got into San Diego and we played and then we went into Oakland, California, and we played at a place called Sweets Ballroom. Well, in the meantime Charlie Barnett came through there and he played at Sweets, and Lena Horne was the vocalist in the band at that time.
